1.1.1.en: Modification to the fan speed to change it from a dropdown to a number field so it supports a tag variable.

1.1.2.en: Fixed fan speed mod to expose a fan speed tag as part of the fan's exposed values.

1.1.3.en: Fan speed accepts numeric flow tags/variables, validates to only accept whole numbers 1-6. Note: existing paired fans automaticality receive the new capability.

1.1.4.en: Not allowing fan speed of less than 1. Must use Turn Off card explicitly so fan speed can be retained for when fan is turned on again. - Dim level now has minimum of 1% instead of 0% for same reason.

1.1.5.en: Fixed the 'Is Light Turned On' card invert functionality, added 'Increase & Decrease dim level' cards as well as 'Toggle light' card.
